key: Hey, you know what?
en: Hey, you know what?
ja: ねえ、知ってる?

key: My Pokémon used a Mist attack the other day, and it totally fogged up the area!
en: My Pokémon used a Mist attack the other day, and it totally fogged up the area!
ja: この前うちのポケモンが「きり」を使ったら、辺り一面すっかり霧に包まれちゃって!

key: It was so thick, it seemed like it had even replaced the terrain itself!
en: It was so thick, it seemed like it had even replaced the terrain itself!
ja: あまりに濃くて、フィールドそのものが変わっちゃったみたいだったよ!

key: It didn't last long though.
en: It didn't last long though.
ja: 長くは続かなかったけどね。

key: All hail He who watches you best...
en: All hail He who watches you best...
ja: あなたを最もよく見守る者に、栄光あれ……

key: All must hail...
en: All must hail...
ja: すべての者よ、栄光をささげよ……

key: All hail...
en: All hail...
ja: 栄光あれ……

key: Hey, Trainer, did you know?
en: Hey, Trainer, did you know?
ja: ねえトレーナー、知ってた?

key: Apparently, the Light Ball, Pikanium-Z, and Eevium-Z all have special properties in this region!
en: Apparently, the Light Ball, Pikanium-Z, and Eevium-Z all have special properties in this region!
ja: でんきだまと、ピカチュウZと、イーブイZは、この地方だと特別な性質があるらしいよ!

key: I haven't got one of my own to test it out, but apparently the Light Ball and Pikanium-Z will also work like an Eviolite and an Everstone!
en: I haven't got one of my own to test it out, but apparently the Light Ball and Pikanium-Z will also work like an Eviolite and an Everstone!
ja: 自分で試したことはないけど、でんきだまとピカチュウZは、しんかのきせきとかわらずのいしみたいにも働くらしい!

key: Eevium-Z supposedly only works like an Everstone, though.
en: Eevium-Z supposedly only works like an Everstone, though.
ja: イーブイZの方は、かわらずのいしとしてしか働かないらしいけどね。

key: Man, this might be what gets me to actually use one of those Pokémon.
en: Man, this might be what gets me to actually use one of those Pokémon.
ja: いやあ、これがあれば、あのポケモンたちを実際に使う気になるかもな。

key: This poor city... what will we do?
en: This poor city... what will we do?
ja: かわいそうな街……これからどうなるんだろう?

key: I went to visit the Day-Care Couple in Obsidia recently, but...
en: I went to visit the Day-Care Couple in Obsidia recently, but...
ja: 最近、オブシディアのポケモンあずかり所の夫婦を訪ねたんだけど……

key: Inside are two hooligans masquerading as an elderly couple behind the counter.
en: Inside are two hooligans masquerading as an elderly couple behind the counter.
ja: 中には、老夫婦のふりをした二人組のならず者が、カウンターの奥にいた。

key: I pray that nothing awful happened to the Day-Care Couple.
en: I pray that nothing awful happened to the Day-Care Couple.
ja: あの夫婦に何も悪いことが起きていませんように。

key: Lord knows I can't do anything about it nowadays...
en: Lord knows I can't do anything about it nowadays...
ja: 今のわたしには、どうすることもできないけれど……

key: ...What's that? The Day-Care Couple was rescued?
en: ...What's that? The Day-Care Couple was rescued?
ja: ……何ですって? あの夫婦、助けられたの?

key: Thank heavens. Perhaps there's hope for this city yet.
en: Thank heavens. Perhaps there's hope for this city yet.
ja: ああ、良かった。この街にもまだ希望があるのかもしれないわね。

key: Hmm... you're a Trainer, yes? Then how about some words of advice from me?
en: Hmm... you're a Trainer, yes? Then how about some words of advice from me?
ja: ふうむ……トレーナーさんだね? それなら、わたしから助言をひとつどうだい?

key: Breeding isn't the only way that Pokémon can learn Egg Moves.
en: Breeding isn't the only way that Pokémon can learn Egg Moves.
ja: ポケモンがタマゴわざを覚える方法は、繁殖だけじゃないんだよ。

key: Try leaving two Pokémon of the same species at the Day Care.
en: Try leaving two Pokémon of the same species at the Day Care.
ja: 同じ種類のポケモンを二匹、あずかり所に預けてごらん。

key: The Pokémon will teach their Egg Moves to each other as long as they have room!
en: The Pokémon will teach their Egg Moves to each other as long as they have room!
ja: 覚える余地がある限り、ポケモン同士でタマゴわざを教え合うんだ!

key: I'm sure this can help your Pokémon reach new heights in battle.
en: I'm sure this can help your Pokémon reach new heights in battle.
ja: きっと、あんたのポケモンをバトルで新たな高みへ導いてくれるはずだよ。
